name: Nuxt Content
description: Nuxt is a Vue application framework; with the Nuxt Content module it renders a folder of Markdown files into a statically generated site.
notes: Nuxt 4.5.2 with @nuxt/content 3.16.1 (nuxt/content repository, first release 2020). Nuxt is an application framework; the content module makes it a Markdown site generator. Static output comes from nuxt generate.
